customManagers.description: Track the burrito-runner tag in the cloud layer; it mirrors upstream burrito versions
Honour `# renovate: datasource=... depName=...` annotations above a version in any YAML file

packageRules.description: Bump the burrito chart, the runner base image and the layer image tag in one PR
k0s forbids skipping a minor, so every rung of the ladder needs its own PR, applied by hand with `make k0sctl`
calibre-web is pinned to a master snapshot for two unreleased Kobo sync fixes; moving it to 0.6.28 or to another snapshot is a manual decision, see gitops/books/calibre-web/ADR.md
ArgoCD Image Updater owns the digests of our own images on a floating main/master tag (gitops/argocd/argocd-image-updater): Renovate bumping them too opens a stale PR after every deploy
devbox applies main within 15 minutes, so every nixos/ bump (lock refresh or nixpkgs branch) is reviewed by hand
